card.title: Declare Allegiance
card.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you wear my ribbon or Nina's for the chess club election?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep us both as friends. Which one do you want as chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. Tell me which ribbon you'll wear then; I'll happily lend you the other one today.

mechanism: A turns friendly neutrality and rotating ribbons into a demand for decisive voting-day allegiance.
confusable: Unlike seeking general friendship, A must make B choose one claimant to authority.
comparison: D58-b separates today's courtesy from tomorrow's consequential sign; D58-a separates policy compromise from who can claim support.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
